instruction: Please help me change the folder view so that email folders are displayed separately for each account instead of combined.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the folder tree view mode from 'smart' (unified inbox) to 'all' (all accounts). The evaluator checks the xulstore.json file for folderTree.mode='all'. This uses the existing check_json metric function with vm_file getter - no custom functions needed. Verified by examining the original xulstore.json which shows folderTree.mode='all' as the default state.
metadata.verification: Verified that folderTree mode in xulstore.json can be 'all' or 'smart' based on user selection in Thunderbird UI.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks that folderTree mode is set to 'all' (showing all accounts separately) vs 'smart' (unified inbox)
Getter logic is appropriate: get_vm_file extracts xulstore.json from Thunderbird profile directory which stores UI configuration
Metric logic correctly navigates nested JSON structure to check the specific key path: chrome://messenger/content/messenger.xhtml -> folderTree -> mode
Expected value 'all' is semantically correct for the instruction requirement of showing folders organized by account
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window and waits to ensure configuration changes are flushed to disk
check_json handles None return values gracefully (lines 300-307 in general.py), mitigating the static type warning
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Static validator warns about type mismatch (get_vm_file returns Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]] vs check_json expects str), but this is handled gracefully by check_json's None checks at runtime - no fix needed unless you want stricter type safety

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
